contexts.text: Spirits applying themselves to the left earlap.
Under Ear, see these references. AC 4654. AC 4656. AC 10061. AE 600:18.
The earlap of the ear = what is apperceptive of the natural man.
(The auricles of the heart mentioned.) DLW 408:2. DWis 6. 7.
On those who constitute the province of the earlap, or external ear. DMin 4779.
The punishment of certain, as among the auriculars.
Such are sent among the auriculars, or those who constitute the cartilaginous skin of the left earlap.
It was a Spirit of the province of the external ear, and in fact of the earlap where the flesh hangs beneath the cartilaginous part, or rather the gross membranaceous cartilage which makes this.
The right earlap = the Perceptive of truth from good.
